description: A warm, California-organic living room corner with a relaxed, layered aesthetic. A small round side table or tray table in terracotta-toned ceramic sits in the foreground, holding a small round terracotta dish. Beside the shelf, a tall narrow vertical wooden element mounted on the wall emits a warm linear glow — a natural wood tube or column form casting warm amber illumination upward and downward along its face.
